raw_text:
PLAN "12-week Bodyweight Strength for Beginner"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build full-body strength with bodyweight progressions"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Upper push/pull":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 3x3..5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Lower & core":
        warmup:
          leg_swings 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Full body":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          inverted_row 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          lunge 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x20..30 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 42m "Upper push/pull":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 3x3..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          plank 3x35..50 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 42m "Lower & core":
        warmup:
          leg_swings 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 42m "Full body":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          inverted_row 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_raise 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 5m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 44m "Upper push/pull":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          plank 4x40..60 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 44m "Lower & core":
        warmup:
          leg_swings 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 44m "Full body":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          inverted_row 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hollow_hold 4x30..45 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper push/pull - test":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x10..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 4x4..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          plank 4x45..60 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower & core - test":
        warmup:
          leg_swings 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x12..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          reverse_lunge 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full body - test":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          inverted_row 4x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 4x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          leg_raise 4x10..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 5m

  PHASE "Phase 2 - Progressive Overload" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper push/pull strength":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 5x10..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 5x5..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          plank 4x60 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Legs & posterior chain":
        warmup:
          leg_swings 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x12..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 4x10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 5x12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          back_extension 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full body volume":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          decline_press 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          inverted_row 5x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          walking_lunge 4x12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hollow_hold 4x40..60 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper push/pull strength":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 5x12..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 5x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          plank 4x60..75 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Legs & posterior chain":
        warmup:
          leg_swings 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x12..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          reverse_lunge 4x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 5x15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          good_morning 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full body volume":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 5x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          inverted_row 5x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 4x12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          leg_raise 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 5m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Upper strength focus":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 5x15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 5x6..10 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          plank 4x75 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 4x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Leg strength focus":
        warmup:
          leg_swings 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 4x12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 5x15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          back_extension 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Full body strength":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          decline_press 5x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          inverted_row 5x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          walking_lunge 5x12..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hollow_hold 4x45..60 rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Upper strength - test":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 5x15..20 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 5x6..10 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          plank 4x90 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 4x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Leg strength - test":
        warmup:
          leg_swings 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x15..20 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          reverse_lunge 5x12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 5x15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          good_morning 4x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Full body - test":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 5x12..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          inverted_row 5x12..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 5x12..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          leg_raise 5x12..20 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 5m

  PHASE "Phase 3 - Strength & Skill" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper heavy":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 6x12..20 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 6x6..10 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          plank 4x90 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 4x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Legs heavy":
        warmup:
          leg_swings 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 6x15..20 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 5x12..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 6x15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          back_extension 4x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Skill & full body":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          decline_press 6x10..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          inverted_row 6x12..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          walking_lunge 5x15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper heavy":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 6x15..20 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 6x6..10 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          plank 4x90 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 4x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Legs heavy":
        warmup:
          leg_swings 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 6x15..20 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          reverse_lunge 5x12..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 6x15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          good_morning 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Skill & volume":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 6x12..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          inverted_row 6x12..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 5x15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          leg_raise 5x15..20 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 5m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper peak":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 6x20 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 6x6..12 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          plank 4x120 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 4x20 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Legs peak":
        warmup:
          leg_swings 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 6x20 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 5x15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 6x20 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          back_extension 4x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Peak test":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          decline_press 6x12..20 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          inverted_row 6x12..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          walking_lunge 6x15..20 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 5x10..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Deload & retest":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 3x2..5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          plank 3x45 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Deload legs":
        warmup:
          leg_swings 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Deload full body":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          inverted_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_raise 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 5m
